title: Top-Up Pricing and Rollover Allowances by Pack, Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs
content:
# Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs — Top-Up and Rollover Allowances

Each pack size of the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs sets four figures for adding units after the original purchase: the smallest top-up that may be bought, the price of one top-up unit, whether a top-up resets the expiry date, and the largest rollover a new pack of that size may receive.

| Pack | Smallest top-up (units) | Price per top-up unit (USD) | Top-up resets the expiry date | Largest rollover into a new pack of this size (percent of its purchased units) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 25 | 15.95 | No | 0 (no rollover) |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 50 | 13.95 | No | 0 (no rollover) |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 100 | 11.45 | Yes | 0 (no rollover) |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 150 | 9.45 | Yes | 25 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 300 | 7.95 | Yes | 25 |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 500 | 6.45 | Yes | 50 |

## Column definitions

- **Smallest top-up** — the smallest top-up purchase, in units.
- **Price per top-up unit** — the price of one top-up unit, in US dollars.
- **Top-up resets the expiry date** — "Yes" means a top-up resets the expiry date to the top-up date plus the pack's unit validity; "No" means it does not.
- **Largest rollover** — the largest number of unused units that may be carried into a new pack bought before expiry, stated as a percentage of the new pack's purchased units. A figure of 0 means no rollover.

## Questions this schedule answers

**Which pack sizes can receive rolled-over units?** Only the First Notice 600-Unit Program (up to 25 percent), the First Notice 1200-Unit Program (up to 25 percent) and the First Notice 2500-Unit Program (up to 50 percent). The rollover percentage belongs to the new pack, not to the older one.

**On which packs does a top-up leave the expiry date unchanged?** The First Notice 50-Unit Program and the First Notice 150-Unit Program.

**What is the smallest top-up on the largest pack?** 500 units, at 6.45 per top-up unit on the First Notice 2500-Unit Program.
